Context: None

Question: Electrical stimulation of the brain for the treatment of chronic pain

Options: 
A. is not effective and can lead to further health complications
B. is of no practical significance, since it can only provide temporary relief.
C. may produce its effects by suppressing the central nervous system
D. is of no practical significance, since stimulation-produced analgesia has been demonstrated only in rats
E. may produce its effects by blocking the pain signals to the brain
F. is generally effective, but medically ill-advised because such stimulation has aversive properties
G. is generally effective, but can lead to addiction
H. may produce its effects by promoting the release of the neurotransmitter norepinephrine
I. may produce its effects by promoting the release of the neurotransmitter serotonin

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
